q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We'll email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes and up to 3 devices. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so 5 people would be $40 per month. Note that annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The Free plan lets you keep up to 100 notes on 1 device. If you need unlimited notes and up to 3 devices, the Plus plan is $4 per month. Let me know if you'd like details on any other plan!

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes! Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase, and you're within that window. Just contact support at support@example.com with your order number, and we'll process your refund. We reply within one business day.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Unfortunately not—Plus subscriptions can only be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase, and three weeks is past that window. If you'd like, I can help you open a support ticket, or you can email support@example.com with your order number to ask about your options.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: No, there is no Linux desktop app. However, Linux users can access Example Notes through any modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later, so Android 11 isn't supported. You could use the web app in a modern browser on your device instead. Let me know if you'd like help with anything else!

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app requires an internet connection. However, the mobile and desktop apps work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export and choose PDF as the format. Your notes will be emailed to you as a ZIP file. Let me know if you need anything else!

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Don't worry—deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days, so yours should still be there. Just open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore" to get it back.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS codes are not supported for two-factor authentication. We support authenticator apps instead, which you can set up under Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, attachments are limited to 25 MB per file. Plus and Team plans allow up to 250 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No — if you cancel via Settings > Billing > Cancel plan, you keep your Plus features until the end of the current billing period. After that, your account switches to the Free plan. Let me know if you need help with anything else!

q: Where do you store my notes?
